content.title: 2026 Oscar predictions: Best Cinematography
content.text: Mark your calendars, Oscars fans, because the 98th Academy Awards will air on Sunday, March 15 on ABC. The annual star-studded ceremony honors movies released in theaters within the 2025 calendar year of eligibility. AMPAS members will vote on the Oscar winners between Feb. 26 and March 5, including Best Cinematography. But what will win? Frankenstein, Marty Supreme, One Battle After Another, Sinners, and Train Dreams received nominations for Best Cinematography on Jan. 22. These five nominees are listed in our gallery below in order of their Gold Derby odds, which are derived from the combined forecasts of experts, editors, and users (updated March 4). Over the decades, the cinematography category has evolved through milestones like separate color and black-and-white awards, the shift to digital video, and historic first nominations for Black artisans (Bradford Young in 2017), women (Rachel Morrison in 2018), and directors (Alfonso Cuarón in 2019). The winners in all 24 categories will be revealed live on air during the Oscars ceremony on March 15. Director: Paul Thomas Anderson Cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Teyana Taylor IMDb: “When their evil enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.” Photo : Netflix3. ‘Train Dreams’ (Adolpho Veloso)Current Odds: 22.66% Distributor: Netflix Director: Clint Bentley Cast: Joel Edgerton, Felicity Jones, William H. Macy IMDb: “Based on Denis Johnson’s beloved novella, Train Dreams is the moving portrait of Robert Grainier, a logger and railroad worker who leads a life of unexpected depth and beauty in the rapidly-changing America of the early 20th Century.” Photo : Ken Woroner/Netflix4. ‘Frankenstein’ (Dan Laustsen)Current Odds: 0.73% Distributor: Netflix Director: Guillermo del Toro Cast: Oscar Isaac, Jacob Elordi, Mia Goth IMDb: “Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.” Photo : A245. ‘Marty Supreme’ (Darius Khondji)Current Odds: 0.16% Distributor: A24 Director: Josh Safdie Cast: Timothée Chalamet, Gwyneth Paltrow, Odessa A’zion IMDb: “Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.”
